breakdown.description: Case described as inviscid but viscosity set to 1e-5; inviscid flow should use zero viscosity
breakdown.reason: The inconsistency was a contradiction between the flow being described as 'inviscid' and the viscosity being set to a non-zero value (1e-5). The generated specification does not address viscosity at all; instead, it provides instructions for temperature boundary conditions. Therefore, the inconsistency was not resolved.
